plain_english_policy: This bill proposes a constitutional amendment to redirect state revenue from offshore oil and gas exploration into a five-year job creation program. Instead of using these funds for general purposes or highway infrastructure, the money would be distributed equally among congressional districts. The Governor and Alabama Development Office are tasked with deciding how each district uses its share specifically to hire new workers or keep current employees on payroll.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would permanently alter state revenue allocation by mandating that offshore oil/gas capital payments (minus debt service) be distributed equally per congressional district for exclusive use in hiring and retaining jobs, while explicitly prohibiting the expenditure of these funds on highway infrastructure projects between 2013 and 2017.
evidence_quotes: "all oil and gas capital payments received by the state for the right to explore and drill... shall be distributed in equal proportions to each congressional district"
"used exclusively to help create jobs and retain existing jobs."
"Provided, however, none of the funds may be utilized to provided highway infrastructure."
